description: Accepts the proposed dinners, saves a Saved Week and makes it This Week in one call. Unchosen dinners use their first different matching choice; existing choices are preserved. Use when the person accepts the proposal, for example use these five. It replaces whatever week the user currently has set, so it suits an explicit request such as 'make this my week now', the person's acceptance is sufficient. save_week is the save that leaves This Week unchanged. Idempotent for the same draft. Requires a linked Chop it account.
name: save_menu
title: Save and activate this week
